title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Elmo?
description:
Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Elmo from Sesame Street, through Franco, the King of Spain and a first lady.

Adolf Hitler → Francisco Franco → Juan Carlos I → Laura Bush → Elmo

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
